name: bg-bubbles

frames.best_why: Frame 1 shows the whole bubble field in its blue-green palette with the caption still legible.

tagline: Soft coloured bubbles drift across a blue sky behind your content.
summary: A full-bleed animated backdrop of about two hundred and fifty soft-edged spheres in blue, green and yellow, floating in front of a very large pale sphere, with a slow warm-to-cool colour shift.
appearance: A bright blue gradient sky fills the frame behind one huge pale sphere. Many smaller spheres in blue, mint green and yellow float at different depths, and centred white text sits slightly softened over the field.
behaviour: Every bubble bobs up and down and the whole palette slowly warms toward orange and cools back to blue on a repeating cycle. The scene stays running while it is mounted and resizes with its parent.
demo_content: The heading 'Bubbles Background' over the line 'A three.js animated gradient bubble scene'.
search_phrases: colorful spheres drifting in the sky
three js bubble scene for a hero
webgl background for a landing page
bubble field with warm and cool colors
use_when: A hero or section needs a playful drifting field of bubbles behind its copy.
avoid_when: It renders continuously in WebGL, and the blur prop also blurs every child, text included.
customise: blur softens the overlay and children render on top; bubble count, both palettes, camera distance and bob speed are constants in the source.
weight_why: About 250 shaded spheres plus a full-screen sphere, re-rendered every frame in WebGL.

a11y.note: Decorative WebGL canvas with no reduced-motion check, and the blur prop softens any child content including text.

issues: The blur prop blurs the whole child layer, so in the frames the heading and subtitle are smeared.
White text sits on bright bubbles with little contrast, making the caption hard to read.
polish_why: Soft, pleasant bubbles; flat shading and a blur washing over the demo text keep it ordinary.
